value.body: The Bachelor of Physiotherapy trains you to assess and treat movement problems caused by injury, illness, surgery or ageing, using exercise, manual therapy and electrotherapy. It ends with a compulsory clinical internship. Physiotherapy is regulated under the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) Act, 2021.

items.label: Course length
items.note: Including internship. The NCAHP framework sets 4 years + a 1-year internship; many colleges still run 4 years + 6 months
items.source: NCAHP curriculum and university ordinances (as reported)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology. For 2026-27, admission is mostly through Class 12 marks, state counselling or university tests (for example GGSIPU CET). NCAHP has deferred a NEET-UG requirement for BPT to 2027-28 (as reported), so check the rule for your year.

value.title: At a glance
items: Physiotherapists work in hospitals, rehabilitation centres, sports settings and their own clinics.
An MPT (2 years) is the usual master's degree and the route to a specialisation.
Course length, entrance and registration rules are changing under NCAHP; check the current notice for your batch.
